top_signals.title: Stocks and Treasuries Decline as Brent Tops $102: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A global stock rally that brought equities within striking distance of an all-time high lost further ground as oil jumped on renewed Middle East tensions, stoking concerns about inflation. Treasuries declined.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
